acceptanceCriteria.text: The Route 3 consumer retains the descriptor-bound expected appliance manifest/raw identities needed for verification.
OCI resolution/materialization verifies the immutable locator/digest and cross-checks the materialized manifest/raw artifact against descriptor expectations.
Raw size and digest mismatches fail closed before VM boot or managed reconciliation.
Verification does not infer semantic Runtime identity from raw/OCI/qcow2 byte identity; artifact identity and semantic identity remain distinct concepts.
Existing v1 deployment descriptors remain readable where compatibility is intentionally supported, but missing evidence cannot be silently upgraded into stronger certification claims.
Regression tests cover wrong manifest digest, wrong raw digest/size, stale cached materialization, and successful exact-match reuse.
Bounded diagnostics identify which identity boundary failed without dumping unbounded artifact content.
The verified identity evidence is available to Route 3/provider certification and final #261 evidence capture.

issue.title: fix(runtime): verify materialized Route 3 appliance identity against the deployment descriptor
